write_up: This is a strong resume! Your work at North Loop Sports Rehab shows the patients you treat, the program you built, and the therapists you mentor. A recruiter can see both your clinical work and your senior responsibilities.
The return-to-run program is the line to copy: it names what you built and how many patients completed it. Your Minnesota license, DPT, and earlier hospital work are easy to find, too.

The main refinement is to give the patient function figure a little more context. Otherwise, your resume isn't likely to be the thing standing between you and a call back. Competition for a particular clinic and a referral can also matter.
